📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Adds KubeletConfig and Subscription gathering: documentation and sample archive data, RBAC update, GroupVersionResource declarations, dynamic-client gatherer implementations that list and marshal resources into records (with status removal for Subscriptions), and unit tests for both gatherers. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Documentation & Samples**
`docs/gathered-data.md`, `docs/insights-archive-sample/config/kubeletconfigs/set-max-pods.json`, `docs/insights-archive-sample/config/subscriptions/openshift-cnv/community-kubevirt-hyperconverged.json`|Adds KubeletConfig entry to gathered-data docs, adds sample KubeletConfig and Subscription JSON archive samples.| |**RBAC**
`manifests/03-clusterrole.yaml`|Extends `insights-operator-gather` ClusterRole to allow `get/list/watch` on `kubeletconfigs` (machineconfiguration.openshift.io).| |**GVResources & Registration**
`pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/const.go`, `pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/clusterconfig_gatherer.go`|Adds `kubeletGroupVersionResource` and `subscriptionVersionResource`; registers `kubeletconfigs`, `subscriptions`, and repositions `node_features` in the gatherer function map.| |**Gatherer Implementations**
`pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/gather_kubeletconfig.go`, `pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/gather_subscription.go`|New gatherers: GatherKubeletConfig lists `kubeletconfigs` and emits `config/kubeletconfigs/{name}` JSON records; GatherSubscription lists `subscriptions`, strips `status`, and emits `config/subscriptions/{namespace}/{name}.json` records. Both use dynamic client and handle NotFound vs other errors.| |**Unit Tests**
`pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/gather_kubeletconfig_test.go`, `pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/gather_subscription_test.go`|Adds tests using fake dynamic client covering zero/one/multiple items, record naming, payload shape, status removal for subscriptions, and specific field validations (e.g., spec.kubeletConfig.maxPods).| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor Gatherer participant DynamicClient as "Dynamic Client" participant KubeAPI as "Kubernetes API" participant Recorder as "Record Builder" Gatherer->>DynamicClient: NewForConfig / Resource(...).List() DynamicClient->>KubeAPI: GET /apis/// KubeAPI-->>DynamicClient: returns items (0..N) or NotFound/Error DynamicClient-->>Gatherer: items or error alt items returned Gatherer->>Gatherer: optionally mutate item (e.g., remove status) Gatherer->>Recorder: build record name and payload for each item Recorder-->>Gatherer: assembled records Gatherer-->>Gatherer: return records, no errors else NotFound Gatherer-->>Gatherer: log not found, return no records, no errors else Error Gatherer-->>Gatherer: return error list end ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Poem > 🐰 I hopped through structs and YAML bright, > I fetched kubelet configs late at night, > I trimmed Subscription status down just right, > RBAC opened doors — what a sprightly sight! 🥕
